subject: Air freight quote request to SGN
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN), including truck pickup from our site in postcode 53629 (Bonn), Germany, and transport to the departure airport? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-23.

The shipment consists of 16 pieces of handheld measuring devices, with a gross weight of 1235 kg and a total volume of 10.24 cbm. The goods are general cargo and non-dangerous. Please find the packing list attached.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR, including the pickup and trucking to the airport.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH
